# Teyezilla Expeditions

> Teyezilla Expeditions is a premium African travel company offering tailor-made
> safaris, signature journeys, and handpicked experiences across Africa, plus fully
> bespoke private travel for guests who want something built entirely around them.

## How the site is organized
- Destinations — country-level guides (best time to visit, visas, health & packing)
- Journeys — curated multi-day itineraries, from single-country signature trips to
  multi-country expeditions
- Experiences — single-day and short activities, grouped into six categories: Wildlife
  & Safari, Beach & Islands, Culture & Heritage, Adventure, Food & Lifestyle, and
  Cities & Local Life
- Safari — the dedicated safari hub: safari-specific tours, themes, and a safari guide
- Collections — hand-curated themes that group journeys and experiences together
  (e.g. The Wild, The Ocean, The Heritage, The Adventure)
- Private Travel / Tailor-Made Trips — fully bespoke itineraries built around a guest's
  own dates, interests, and budget, plus an AI trip planner for a first draft

## Destinations (open for booking)
Kenya, Tanzania, Zanzibar, Egypt, Morocco, Rwanda, Uganda, South Africa —
Maasai Mara and Serengeti safaris, Zanzibar beach holidays, the Pyramids and Nile,
Marrakech and the Sahara, gorilla trekking, and Cape Town and the Garden Route.

## Destinations (coming soon)
Namibia, Botswana, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Seychelles, Mauritius

## Booking
Booking is inquiry-based: visitors send an enquiry through the website (or WhatsApp),
a travel consultant replies with a personal quote, and payment is arranged offline
(bank transfer, invoice, or in person). No payment is taken online -- this is
permanent, not a launch-phase limitation.
